title: bdw-world-heavyweight
label: “The Irish Bastard” Sean McClancy
how: Won the triple-threat World Title match at The Return I, pinning Emilio Dervante after knocking him down with the title belt; JJ Jarone was the third man.
note: A rematch with Dervante, rebooked as a ladder match for 27 June 2004 (Anger & Rage) on BDW's own 7th Static, doesn't survive in the held record; McClancy was still champion at the held record's last title snapshot (cgi-bin/champions.cgi).

title: bdw-broken
label: Brock RockHard

won.source: BDW's own results page for The Return I ("Brock Rockhard is our new Broken Champion"), /promotions/bdw/archive/the-return-i-2004-05-30.html

how: Won a five-way Broken Title match at The Return I over Methid, Rob Zone, Jeremy Page and Pretty Boy Evans, pinning Rob Zone with a set-up inverted DDT.
note: Retained against Rob Zone on BDW's own 7th Static (6 Jun 2004, submission via a kneeling Dragon Sleeper) and was still champion at the held record's last title snapshot.

title: bdw-hardcore
label: Arik Caine

won.source: BDW's own results page for The Return I ("Arik Caine is the new Hardcore Champion!"), /promotions/bdw/archive/the-return-i-2004-05-30.html

how: Won a Hardcore Elimination Match at The Return I, pinning Jackson Kable, The Rebel and finally Andrew Irving, after hitting Co-Owner Jeffery with a 2x4.
note: Refused to defend the title against Methid on the 7th Static, citing a threatened lawsuit against Co-Owner Jeffery. BDW's own later champions.cgi snapshot shows the Hardcore title with no listed champion — the title changed hands or went vacant off-page at some point after, undocumented in the held record. The win itself is staged on The Return I's own results page, recovered with the operator's 8 June 2004 site backup.
